title: Horse Tracks: Waddle making an early impact

sources.title: Horse Tracks: Waddle making an early impact
sources.description: If you want to know how much wide receiver Jaylen Waddle is bringing to the offense this year, just ask the defense. “[He’s been] everything that he is expected to be,” said safety Talanoa Hufanga, who played against Waddle when he was with the Dolphins. “I’m super excited that he is on our side.” But […]
